notas: Default storefront robots.txt says buy-for-me agents must not complete payment without a final review step, and points integrators to Checkout Kit. A Shopify engineer said the change "doesn't add or remove any rules": it is a comment, not an enforced rule.

First reported by The Information on 2025-07-30; Amazon did not comment. This article does not name the agents: per Search Engine Journal, Amazon's robots.txt still fully disallows GoogleAgent-Mariner and GoogleAgent-Shopping as of 2026-09-22. Agent type "nube" is based on TechCrunch (May 2025): Google moved Project Mariner to cloud virtual machines on 2025-05-20 (https://techcrunch.com/2025/05/20/google-rolls-out-project-mariner-its-web-browsing-ai-agent/). The type of GoogleAgent-Shopping is unknown.

Cloudflare de-listed Perplexity as a verified bot and added managed rules that block its stealth crawling. Cloudflare is a network provider: the block applies to its customers' sites, including free plans. Perplexity used undeclared user agents and IPs to evade no-crawl directives.

Date is the effective date of the current User Agreement. Section 8.2 bans bots, crawlers, browser plugins and unauthorized automated methods; AI agents are not named specifically. See also https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a1341387

Confirmed by an Amazon spokesperson. Enforced with a block notice shown to the agent, not via robots.txt. Users saw: "Continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use". Muse runs in a cloud virtual machine with its own browser.
